title: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 + Real-ESRGAN Upscale
description: Instruction-driven image editing with Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 and the Lightning 4-step LoRA, followed by optional Real-ESRGAN x4plus upscaling. Accepts a base64 image plus an edit prompt and an optional style reference image.

input.name: Base model
input.description: Hugging Face repo id of the Qwen-Image-Edit base model.

input.name: Use Lightning LoRA
input.description: Few-step Lightning LoRA: much faster at 4-8 steps. Disable for full 40-step sampling.

input.name: Default inference steps
input.description: Used when a request omits "steps". 4-8 with Lightning, ~40 without.

input.name: CPU offload
input.description: Enable on GPUs smaller than 80 GB. Slower and needs plenty of host RAM.
